verdict.rationale: Firebase's official CLI documents importing and exporting users into and out of Firebase Auth, which is a first-party export path for one slice of data. The pack has no evidence of a complete export covering Firestore, Realtime Database or Storage, and the formats are never specified. A community user's belief that their JSON data is easy to export is a self-imposed arrangement, so it earns no credit, and general lock-in complaints are not concrete counter-evidence. Missing for 10: documented full-project export of Firestore/Realtime Database/Storage data, explicit open-format specification (JSON/CSV etc.), migration/offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.
